log_limitations: These are the query batches retained in the session ledger, not a complete reproducible search-engine result export. Additional exact-title lookups included Wordsworth 2021, Rosenblatt 2016, Carboni 2025 and McNeil 2025; books and earlier project assessments also informed discovery. Search rankings and indexed excerpts can change.
screening: Prioritize original research, official producer documentation and author/publisher books. Exclude news/reposts as evidence. Keep inaccessible primary sources as previews or metadata leads. Retain disagreement and model alternatives.
access_limitations: Crossref exact-DOI enrichment attempted for 46 records; many HTTP 429 responses; did not retry aggressively or treat failures as successful retrievals.
Some publisher and PMC pages were blocked or unavailable. Reading status is limited accordingly.
No new third-party scientific dataset or code imported; temporary article copies and fetched abstracts are excluded from committed exports.
coverage_gaps: Full cross-language search and citation chasing
Accretion chronology, mantle rheology and reaction kinetics beyond the selected anchors
Independent reconstruction or numerical reproduction of cited results
relationship_to_existing_catalog: This supplement does not update the 1990-record catalog or its earlier reading totals; sources overlap and counts must not be added.
